mostWorthwhile.text: Adding vessels to the deeper tissue was most worthwhile: it explained how living outer cells get supplies even though their layer has no blood vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat outlet was straightforward but repetitive after already building it, and the fitting gave no new picture detail.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer skin layer has no blood vessels and gets supplies from the tissue underneath.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and named slots made the parts' purposes clear, though the last fitting was the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing how the skin's layers, vessels, gland and nerves work together made me curious about other body structures.
